last_quelle_ram: in use (without buffers and cache), the highest of each hour
last_quelle_load: average of the last minute, the highest of each hour
last_quelle_nutzer_cpu: share of the machine for the app's user
last_quelle_nutzer_ram: from the cgroup of the app's user
einst_nav_werte_text: apply to all installations of an app
einst_werte_apps: Apps with values of the operator
einst_werte_gilt_eins: Applies to the one installation of {app}
einst_geheim_neu: new value; leave empty to keep the current one
dienst_fehler_kein_server: This server does not exist or is revoked.
dienst_fehler_server_verwaltet: The agent reads units only on a server that is only observed.
dienst_fehler_server_voll: The agent already reads 100 services on this server and takes no more.
dienst_nutzer_hinweis: Empty for units of the system.
dienst_units_hinweis: Separated by spaces. The agent only reads their state with systemctl show; it starts and stops nothing.
dienst_port_hinweis: Optional: with a path an HTTP check, without one a TCP check.
dienst_innen_kein_server: The agent reads units only on a server that is only observed; none is connected yet.
